purpose: Improve the unified Basic action policy using public APPO expert demonstrations.
student_observation: Existing 320x240 HUD-off structured visible state; same-seed synchronized environment; no expert pixels or hidden state added to input.

initialization.model: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B with existing dynamic decision head
initialization.source: Selected original unified SFT checkpoint, before outcome or TD training

training.selection: Minimum pool-weighted dev target CE including step zero; heldout never selects checkpoints.

data.retain: Every original Maze, Snake and Predict Position row verbatim, including its split and labels.
data.filtering: Keep all expert episodes and every visited pre-action state, including failures and exploration.
data.hard_target: Expert argmax before action sampling; distinct from epsilon exploration action.
data.soft_target: Normalized raw APPO action probabilities; excludes epsilon behavior mixture.
data.legacy_cases: Previous 48 Basic cases are historical regression cases, not the new heldout cohort.

evaluation.primary_metric: Episode success from observed kill before the native deadline.
evaluation.regression: Original Maze/Snake/Predict Position test and OOD, unchanged greedy+0.15 controller.
evaluation.calibration: Action-label calibration measures expert action agreement, not probability of winning.

primary.selection: Named before evaluating any APPO outcomes; do not select a checkpoint or controller on test or OOD.
